metadata.price_source: Workshop owner: before-tax sheet purchase prices supplied on 2026-10-28. These are the calculation inputs, not scraped retail prices.
metadata.money_unit: One cent is 0.01 CAD. All fields ending in _cents are whole integers.
metadata.thickness_unit: Both inches and millimetres are recorded; 1 inch = 25.4 mm. Repeating conversions are stored to 10 decimal places.
metadata.actual_thickness_source: The owner measured the nominal 5.2 mm sheet at 4.75 mm. Other actual thicknesses await measurement.
metadata.shipping_policy: Flat landed shipping allowance per sheet; no additional inbound HST is added to this allowance.
metadata.display_thickness_policy: display_thickness contains customer-facing shop categories in each unit system, not exact conversions or measured thicknesses. Exact supplier nominal dimensions remain in nominal_thickness; measured values remain in actual_thickness.
